name: Construct
summary: A project management web app for organizing projects, tasks, and team access.
description: Construct is a React and Go project management application. Its committed frontend includes project, task, task-detail, login, and sign-up screens. The Go API uses Fiber, PostgreSQL, and JWT-protected routes for project and task operations.

sections.title: Project overview
sections.summary: A team project-management application organized around projects and tasks.

sections.title: React frontend
sections.summary: The Vite and React Router interface includes project, task list, task details, login, and sign-up pages.

sections.title: Authentication and API
sections.summary: A Go Fiber API exposes versioned project and task routes and protects account-specific operations with JWT middleware.

sections.title: PostgreSQL data layer
sections.summary: The Go backend connects to PostgreSQL using pgx and reads credentials from environment configuration.

sections.title: Container setup
sections.summary: The repository includes Dockerfiles and a Compose setup for the frontend and backend; the checked-in configuration expects an externally supplied backend environment file.

frontend.publish_reason: The frontend depends on the Go API, while backend startup requires PostgreSQL credentials and the repository has no checked-in schema/migration or safe local database bootstrap. Enable publishing after those upstream requirements are documented and configured.

compose.reason: Requires PostgreSQL and credentials; no checked-in schema/bootstrap or env example is available.

render.reason: Database bootstrap and production authentication secrets are not defined.
